title: The app does not separate direct usage from word-family or teaching examples
why: The picker combines explicit links, reverse links and spelling matches, then puts the first five under Used In A Sentence. Those are different kinds of evidence.
proposal: Show Direct usage, Related forms, and Teaching notes separately. Prefer reviewed direct examples; retain source provenance.

title: Additional examples are hidden after the first five
why: The app returns more than five examples for some entries but renders only the first five, with no way to view the rest.
proposal: Add a count and View all examples. Keep a short preview.

title: Examples are attached to a whole word, not to its individual senses
why: A word with multiple meanings has one shared example list. The reader cannot tell which meaning each sentence demonstrates.
proposal: Associate reviewed examples with the sense they illustrate; label examples awaiting that assignment. Do not infer sense assignments from spelling alone.

title: Some headwords have no example
why: These entries have no example returned by the app. That is a coverage gap, not proof that the words are wrong. Roots and affixes may need a labeled construction instead of a sentence.
proposal: Develop examples in reviewed batches; do not insert generated sentences automatically.
